messages:
sara: seeing a spike of 502/504s for hosted inference in us-west-2a since 11:20 UTC. multiple customers reporting long tails, p50 fine but p95/p99 exploding. graphs show egress packet loss to provider AS64512. · logs attached from gateway: `gateway: upstream read timeout, status=502, conn=10.2.4.7`

tom-oncall: looking. I see TCP retransmit spike and 30-40% packet loss on egress to that next-hop. Are we able to shift traffic to fallback provider? :thinking:

ivy-net: confirmed — temporary blackhole on provider peer. BGP path to AS64512 shows withdraws from 11:18-11:25 then intermittent reachability. working on contacting provider NOC.

jake-support: CS getting escalations from three customers (ticket #7892, #7901, #7906). They reported request timeouts and 502s around 11:20–11:45 UTC. We told them were investigating and to expect an update in 15m.

sara: repro steps from one customer: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-1b","input":"hello"}'` — they saw immediate 502s. Also attach a tcpdump snippet: `tcpdump -nni eth0 host 198.51.100.12 and port 443` shows retransmits and RSTs.

ivy-net: quick mitigation suggestion: 1) shift outgoing flows for us-west-2a to backup egress prefix via provider AS64513 (traffic-shift runbook step). 2) enable short-lived retries to fallback model instance in us-west-2b. 3) throttle noisy clients to reduce queueing at gateway.

tom-oncall: starting traffic-shift now (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%). pinging infra to confirm BFD timers won't flap. deploy-bot: kerberos-check? :gear:

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job queued -> started canary at 11:36 UTC. health checks green for canary.

jake-support: letting CS know. CS note to customers: "We're routing around an egress provider issue that caused 502s for a subset of US-West requests. You may see temporary retries; we're monitoring and will update."

ivy-net: provider NOC acknowledged a routing issue on their transit fabric and are investigating an internal blackholing event. theyve opened ticket TRA-1221.

sara: after traffic-shift p95 dropped back to normal within 3 minutes. we still see small error tail for customers pinned to us-west-2a dedicated pools — recommend forcing failover for dedicated pools until provider fixes.

tom-oncall: creating incident runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4071239999 and assigning postmortem. tagging eng-sre for follow-up on egress resilience patterns.

cs-leah: CS will follow up with impacted customers with root-cause once provider confirms. thanks for quick responses. :heart:

ivy-net: follow-up action items: capture pcap for 11:15-11:50, keep TRA-1221 open until full BGP stability, add automated detection for sudden egress AS loss >5min.

sara: noted. closing escalation for now; will reopen if errors reappear.
